TREATMENT OF LUNG CANCER
Treatment
- Depends on the staging
- mainstay for stage I disease (wedge resection, segmentectomy,
lobectomy, pneumonectomy, mediastinal node sampling)
- Surgery + adjuvant chemotherapy: stages II and III disease
- Palliative chemotherapy + radiotherapy: for stage IV disease
- Targeted therapy: in selected cases (eg vascular endothelial growth
factor inhibitor like bevacizumab)
Prevention
- Avoidance of smoking including secondhand smoke
- Reducing occupational exposure to lung carcinogens
- Reduction of air pollution
